program.publisher.note: Flipboard has a publisher program on its own site, where publishers apply and its team reviews submitted feeds. News Distribution needs no application for the feed itself.

topic.suggestion.note: Flipboard indexes and tags stories by subject itself. News Distribution adds a suggested topic as a plain category element; Flipboard does not document that it reads it, and makes the final choice.

feed.full_text.note: Full text in every item. Flipboard's own feed page was not read.

image.size.note: The feed carries the width and height of the featured image. Flipboard's own feed page was not read.

feed.items.note: The feed holds the latest 25 articles. This is News Distribution's own size, not a Flipboard limit.
